item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00158","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C01","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 supplies a concrete, nearly clause-for-clause template for the child: it authorizes inspection of specified tax returns during the Eighty-second Congress by a named Senate committee or authorized subcommittee, states the committee-specific investigative purpose, incorporates conditions in a Treasury decision approved the same date, and uses the identical Federal Register effectiveness clause. The child principally substitutes the tax-year range, committee, and subject of study. C01 and C23 use substantially the same machinery, but C12 is the closest match in phrasing and congressional duration.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any income tax return for the years 1946 to 1950, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-second Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Interior and Insular Affairs or any duly authorized subcommittee thereon","parent_excerpt":"any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for any period to and including 1950 shall, during the Eighty-second Congress, be open to Inspection by the Senate Committee on Rules and Administration or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof","explanation":"The same operative sentence structure and administrative mechanism are retained while the covered returns and Senate committee are changed."},{"child_excerpt":"in connection with its studies of relations of the United States with the Indians and the Indian tribes and measures relating to the care, education, and management of Indians","parent_excerpt":"in connection with its studies of matters relating to the election of Members of Congress, corrupt practices, contested elections, credentials and qualifications, and Federal elections generally","explanation":"Both insert the recipient committee's particular jurisdiction into the same purpose clause."},{"child_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee, approved by me this date. This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","parent_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the Inspection of such returns by that committee, approved by me this date. This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.","explanation":"This distinctive paired closing—incorporation of a contemporaneously approved Treasury decision followed by immediate effectiveness upon Federal Register filing—is essentially identical."}]}
